تستقربون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِبُونَ (tastaqribūna) /tas.taq.ri.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# تُسْتَقْرَبُونَ (tustaqrabūna) /tus.taq.ra.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
